meta.description: Ana Prado Institution (IAP): a community charity in Pau Amarelo, Pernambuco, Brazil, created in honor of Grandma Ana Prado. Learn our story, our projects and how to help.

cover.tagline: In loving memory of Grandma Ana Prado (1951–2023)
cover.photoAlt: Photo of Grandma Ana Prado smiling
cover.illustrationAlt: Illustration of downtown Pau Amarelo, with the sea, coconut palms and colorful little houses
